mostWorthwhile.text: Making stars near the shared centre was most worthwhile: they belong to the emerging galaxy rather than either original spiral.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final shell encounter felt least involving because it was the only available action, although its result connected the gas histories.

surprise.text: The new central stars belong from birth to neither original spiral.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though the shell encounter's connection to the remaining goal was not clear until its result.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow the gathered gas toward the centre, though the final choice itself was automatic in practice.
